name: prioritybar
need: Keep a row of actions on one line at any width: what does not fit folds into a More menu

--ds-priority-bar-gap.description: priority action bar: the gap between its actions at the comfortable density (1px less per density step)

--ds-priority-bar-menu-width.description: priority action bar: the least width of its More menu

labExempt.DS.prioritybar.create: no motion: an action folds and unfolds at once; the menu's entrance is DS.menu's
labExempt.DS.prioritybar.plan: a pure function of the widths
